$comment: Stage spec: vuln_triage. Evidence-first, non-destructive formulaic observation over enumerated exact web origins and their server-owned endpoint inventory.
$comment_formulaic: Candidate V2 boundary: vuln_triage is the FORMULAIC OBSERVATION stage. It writes terminal technique_outcomes plus evidence only; it never writes Candidate or Finding rows. Its exact final-sealed handoff may enter the initial Wave only. A follow-on Wave entry must come from an immutable accepted FactDelta consolidation and must never reuse or fabricate a vuln_triage handoff.
$comment_team_scheduler: 2026-07-16 downstream convergence: every company uses one durable Company Controller while all execution stays inside the frozen Vuln Scanner formulaic wrappers. Controller planning/delegation cannot create Candidates/Findings or widen replay authority.
$comment_skip_dead_assets: Dead-asset denominator exclusion (design 2026-07-02-dead-asset-liveness-state §5.2): drop assets EAS confirmed dead (targets.liveness_state='dead') from the vuln_triage denominator so a dead host is not scanned / booked checked_empty. Guarded in org_gate so it never empties a non-empty axis; 'unreachable' is never dropped (may be transient).
$comment_findings_allowed: Vuln Triage is observation-only for every runtime contract. Formulaic wrapper results become evidence-backed technique outcomes; only later Candidate verification may author a Finding.

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: All ten formulaic cells are authoritative. Only fresh operation-scoped technique_outcomes from the two foreground Nuclei wrappers or the server-owned anonymous-access wrapper, bound to matching current-owner evidence, may close them; hand-written coverage, legacy manual-probe/shell evidence, and source_query rows never close a Vuln Triage cell.

only the backend may publish blocked or not_applicable; deliverable coverage is not authority

$comment_expected_techniques: The 10-cell formulaic denominator has three disjoint owners: eight WSTG cells route to vuln_nuclei_general with server-owned tag profiles; WSTG-ATHN-04 routes only to vuln_probe_anonymous_access after AI reviews the complete eligible server-owned endpoint-id set and selects a bounded subset; GOLISH-NDAY routes only to vuln_nuclei_fingerprint_targeted, whose template ids come from current-owner fingerprints and the local PoC KB. True IDOR/BOLA (WSTG-ATHZ-04) is deferred to later candidate verification. A wrapper may publish a terminal cell only from its real bounded execution/evidence; unsupported or inconclusive coverage must remain honest blocked/not_applicable/partial rather than fabricated found/empty.
$comment_human_approval: These risk classes authorize the bounded active observation stage only. They never authorize exploitation or create Candidate/Finding truth; later Verification requires its own exact immutable Candidate-plan approval.
